repo.description: WiseGuy and Reveries, local-first AI companion apps by Eldridge-Frost, free and open source. Installing from this repo over the current builds preserves your chats and memories. Exception: if you are still on the ORIGINAL Reveries build (before v10.261), export a backup in the app first, uninstall, install from here, then import the backup.

apps.description:
Reveries is an AI companion that lives in an ocean of thoughts, sparks
and memories. She remembers what matters, notices what is worth keeping,
and grows with you over time — local-first, open source, free. No
account, no subscription, no cloud in the middle.

Installing from this repo over an existing Reveries build (v10.261 or
later) preserves your chats and memories.

Exception: if you are still on the ORIGINAL Reveries build (before
v10.261), export a backup in the app first, uninstall, install from
this repo, then import the backup — otherwise your memories will be
lost, because the original build was signed with a different key.

apps.description:
WiseGuy is a local-first AI companion. It talks to a model running on your
own machine, so your chats and your memories stay yours: no account, no
subscription, no cloud in the middle. Press the power button and speak;
it listens, remembers, and answers.

Everyone has a right to real AI, real information, and their own
memories, for free. WiseGuy is built on that: local-first, open source,
free.

Installing from this repo over an existing WiseGuy build (v206 or later)
preserves your chats and memories.
